body:
## Description

On Windows, `uv self update` fails when `ALL_PROXY` is configured with a SOCKS5 proxy. The updater fails to download the new version because the download mechanism used by the Windows installer does not support the `socks5://` proxy scheme.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Install a version of `uv` older than the latest available release (e.g. `0.13.3` when testing against `0.13.4`).
2. Configure `ALL_PROXY` to use a SOCKS5 proxy.
3. Run `uv self update` in PowerShell.

```powershell
$env:ALL_PROXY = "socks5://127.0.0.1:9050"
uv self update
```

The update must have a newer version available; otherwise, `uv self update` will report that it is already up to date without attempting the download.

## Actual behavior

The update fails while downloading the new version:

```text
info: Checking for updates...
error: The installation failed. Output from the installer: downloading uv 0.13.4 (x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)
failed to download from https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.4
  failed to download https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.4/uv-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip to
       ...\uv.zip: The ServicePointManager does not support proxies with the socks5 scheme.
trying alternative download URL
failed to download from https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/0.13.4
  failed to download https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/0.13.4/uv-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip to
       ...\uv.zip: The ServicePointManager does not support proxies with the socks5 scheme.
failed to download binaries
```

The command exits with code `2`. Both the primary download URL and the GitHub fallback fail with the same error.

## Expected behavior

`uv self update` should be able to download and install updates when `ALL_PROXY` points to a SOCKS5 proxy, consistently with SOCKS5 support in `uv`'s own HTTP client.

## Additional verification

I reproduced the failure with two installed versions:

| Installed version | Update target | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `0.11.8` | `0.13.4` | Fails |
| `0.13.3` | `0.13.4` | Fails |

In the same environment, I was able to download and run `uv 0.13.4` through `uvx`:

```powershell
uvx uv --version
# uv 0.13.4 (7456b60bc 2026-10-20 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)
```

This suggests that the failure is specific to the standalone self-update download path, rather than a general inability to download or execute `uv` through the configured proxy.

## Possible cause

The Windows PowerShell installer appears to use .NET's `System.Net.WebClient` and `System.Net.WebProxy` for downloading the release archive. This mechanism rejects the `socks5://` proxy scheme with the reported `ServicePointManager` error.

A SOCKS5-compatible download mechanism, or reuse of `uv`'s own HTTP client for the download, may resolve the issue.


### Platform

Windows 11 x86_64

### Version

uv 0.13.3 (502f93ca6 2026-10-19 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)

### Python version

_No response_
title: `uv self update` fails with SOCKS5 proxy on Windows
